results.title: City of Pigs
results.overview: In a future where world leaders are chosen by lottery, Lenny Hicks, a former rock star, becomes Prime Minister of the United Kingdom against his will.

results.title: Exil intérieur
results.overview: After fleeing the economic crisis in Lebanon, Wael settles in Paris with his wife and daughter. While his wife finds a job, he remains unemployed, destabilized in his identity as a father and a man.

results.title: Tchaikovsky: Eugene Onegin - Teatro alla Scala
results.original_title: Tchaikovsky: Eugene Onegin - Teatro alla Scala
results.overview: Teatro alla Scala presents a new production of Tchaikovsky’s masterpiece of unrequited love, drawn from Pushkin’s novel. Acclaimed soprano Aida Garifullina stars as Tatyana, the naïve young girl who grows into a sophisticated beauty. Baritone Alexey Markov sings the title role of the nobleman who lives to regret his blasé rejection of Tatyana’s love and his careless incitement of a fatal duel with his best friend Lensky (Dmitry Korchak). The tender music is entrusted to the exciting Timur Zangiev, and staging is in the hands of prolific stage and film director Mario Martone, now in his tenth La Scala production.

results.title: RIP
results.overview: Leonardo, an obituary author, lives an isolated and disillusioned life, which is completely turned upside down when he befriends an eccentric group of ghosts. Among them there is also the spirit of Leonardo's father, in a youthful and enthusiastic version that his son does not remember ever experiencing.

results.title: I rörelse
results.overview: Five girls make their way through town to a party. Coming-of-age film about the little moments of adolescence that may not feel big at the time but that you will remember.

results.title: Jorge Quer Ser Repórter
results.overview: Among the hardships that Jorge experiences with his best friend, in the countryside of Paraíba, it is right in the middle of the world that he will get closer to his dream of being a reporter.

results.title: The Wave
results.overview: A music student’s testimony ignites a feminist uprising on her campus, where protest becomes performance and collective voice becomes an act of resistance.

results.title: Tenez
results.overview: Before a crucial tennis championship, Leo encounters his former coach, who physically abused him nearly ten years ago. Leo, who has been struggling with mental health problems since then, threatens to spiral out of control, caught between the tennis court and the gambling halls.

results.title: Bonehead
results.overview: The soon-to-be victim of a slasher film finds herself in the unexpected predicament of meeting the killer on his lunch break.

results.title: The Old Way
results.overview: In a chaotic era rife with bandits, rogue gangster Peng Yinan and his brothers Lei Wu and Ma Ming scrape by as outlaws. A mysterious woman Zhuang Yue hires them with a gold bar to kidnap a bride from a ruthless bandit stronghold. During the mission, Peng discovers his long-sought archenemy—the man who massacred his family years ago—hidden among the criminals. Fueled by vengeance, Peng launches a brutal assault to settle scores and annihilate the gang.

results.title: A Newport Christmas
results.overview: A charitable and spirited Newport socialite in 1905 finds out her father intends for her to become engaged to a man she’s never met at the upcoming Christmas Eve ball. When she wishes for a different life, a man appears — and she somehow time-travels to 2025.

results.title: Sophia
results.overview: Against the wishes of her father, Emily travels from London to Tunisia in the hopes of reconnecting her daughter, Sophia, with her estranged husband. The unthinkable happens when Sophia disappears, and lies and deceit quickly ensnare the broken family. Emily’s world is flipped upside down as she races against time to find her daughter.

results.title: The Night Shift
results.overview: Emrah, who works as a receptionist in the night shift of a boutique hotel, is constantly monitored by his boss Adem through security cameras and this surveillance becomes increasingly irritating.

results.title: Origen
results.overview: A choreographer in the midst of creation embarks on a journey though the traces of her memories in Columbia, shaped by the violence of the 1990s. Her memories lead her into a new space of introspection, body perception, and time, allowing her to become a woman free to exist.

results.title: Ring Ring
results.overview: An entertaining and light-hearted depiction of how a seemingly innocent game can unravel deep secrets and test the strength of friendship and relationships.

results.title: MMA - A Fathers Fight
results.overview: When Max, a former MMA world champion about to retire, discovers he has an 8-year-old autistic son, his life is turned upside down. Now, as he trains for one last opportunity to regain his world champion title, Max must deal with his new family and his father, from whom he has long been estranged.

results.title: Custom Love
results.overview: In the immensity of the desert, this voice resounds.  A question, a quest, a hesitation. Three choices... and yet, it is only by daring to see otherwise that the obvious appears. Mr. P already knew it. And you?

results.title: Ancestry Road
results.overview: When Kevin's daughter continually goes missing up the back of their Scottish farm, he builds a road to make life easier. Yet when deceased family members begin arriving in their cars for a visit, everything changes.
